defects.summary: Directive 150 implementation was staged locally but absent from remote master; delivered in real implementation commit with full test suites and verified lineage
defects.directiveRequirement: Establish exact relationship among uploaded report, working tree, implementation commit, and remote HEAD; make source changes available in real implementation commit on master; ensure git log and git diff demonstrate actual source delivery; run tests against the clean commit.
defects.remediationDetails: Delivered all Directive 150 source implementations, unit tests, catalog scripts, and adapters in reviewable git commit. Synchronized remote baseline 412c8c6339b2a6355f71b853d686c9601fd2037d to new implementation commit containing all modified operational files (scripts/execute_staging_directive_139.mjs, scripts/lib/stagingAuthorization.mjs, scripts/lib/stagingExecutionPlan.mjs, supabase/migrations/069_candidate_referential_integrity_reconciliation.sql, test suites, and schema reports).

defects.workstream: P1: Natural-Key Definitions Reconciled with Committed DDL
defects.summary: Reconciled conflict targets in stagingExecutionPlan.mjs: organization_relationships includes valid_from; organization_multilingual_names includes script_code, representation_type, and name_value
defects.directiveRequirement: Ensure documented conflict targets in scripts/lib/stagingExecutionPlan.mjs match actual constraints in schema migrations: organization_relationships must use source_org_id,target_org_id,relationship_type,valid_from; organization_multilingual_names must use organization_id,language_code,script_code,representation_type,name_value; update verifiedConflictKeys and conflictTargets mappings.
defects.remediationDetails: Updated verifiedConflictKeys and stages.stage1_political_organizations.conflictTargets in scripts/lib/stagingExecutionPlan.mjs: public.organization_relationships set to 'source_org_id,target_org_id,relationship_type,valid_from' (matching uq_org_rel); public.organization_multilingual_names set to 'organization_id,language_code,script_code,representation_type,name_value' (matching uq_org_multi_name). Aligned with reports/w021_5_schema_contract_specification.json and scripts/lib/stage1IdempotentReconciler.mjs.

defects.summary: Corrected column types for vw_legacy_election_results: constituency_id is TEXT (not UUID), election_type is TEXT (not enum), and parties are TEXT (not UUID); asserted in test suite
defects.directiveRequirement: Verify exact column types produced by vw_legacy_election_results view against underlying DDL: constituency_id is TEXT, election_type is TEXT with CHECK constraint; document all 16 projected columns and their real PostgreSQL types in reports/w021_5_canonical_election_registry.json; verify tests/historical-election-results-23-states.test.mjs Check 4 asserts underlying column types without asserting nonexistent UUID/enum columns.
defects.remediationDetails: Updated scripts/build_canonical_election_registry.mjs and regenerated reports/w021_5_canonical_election_registry.json: constituency_id typed as TEXT (from ec.constituency_id), election_type typed as TEXT (from ee.election_type), winner_party and runner_up_party typed as TEXT (from w_c.party_id / r_c.party_id referencing political_organizations.id). Documented all 16 projected columns in schema contract specification. Hardened tests/historical-election-results-23-states.test.mjs Check 4 to assert all 16 columns and exact underlying DDL types.

defects.workstream: P1: Migration 069 Catalog Verification Environment Limitation
defects.summary: Local PostgreSQL daemon offline on port 5432 in Windows host environment; offline catalog introspection, AST syntax validation, and constraint definitions maintained and verified without false live claims
defects.directiveRequirement: If local PostgreSQL is unavailable in the environment, document this limitation truthfully in verification report rather than claiming it was tested live; verify migration statically and syntactically; ensure test suite falls back gracefully to catalog and syntax validation without failing tests or reporting false live passes.
defects.remediationDetails: Probed TCP port 5432 and verified local PostgreSQL daemon is unavailable in this environment (TcpTestSucceeded: False). Documented this constraint transparently in Directive 151 reporting. Executed tests/migration-069-referential-integrity.test.mjs (8/8 PASS) validating AST syntax, DDL structure, PL/pgSQL DO blocks, pg_constraint catalog introspection queries (conrelid, confrelid, confdeltype = 'r', convalidated = true), and transaction boundaries without false live assertions.
